compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Summary
Update CLAUDE.md Architecture section with concise one-line descriptions of the new CI llm-review architecture, 3-tier version resolution, and auto-detect runner mode shipped in epic 5d6e-86a9.

## Testing Mode
UPDATE — existing file, behavior change (CLAUDE.md content update with structural test).

## Acceptance Criteria
- GIVEN the CLAUDE.md Architecture section
  WHEN it is read by an agent
  THEN it describes: (a) ci-llm-review-runner.sh as the CI llm-review orchestrator, (b) the 3-tier version resolution chain (local plugins/dso/ → dso channel → dso-dev channel) for host-project CI, (c) the auto-detect runner mode (local-checkout vs fetched-assets, marker file plugins/dso/.dso-source-of-truth), (d) parallel overlay dispatch protocol (overlays fire concurrently with tier reviewer), (e) CI divergence from local (does not consult check-usage.sh)
- GIVEN the existing CLAUDE.md style (one-line architecture entries referencing linked docs)
  WHEN this task is complete
  THEN added lines follow the same style — no verbose inline implementation details
- A structural test in tests/ verifies the new architecture lines exist in CLAUDE.md (grep-based or content assertion)

## Files to Modify
- CLAUDE.md (Architecture section — add 5 one-line entries, reference ci-llm-review-runner.sh and CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md)
- tests/scripts/ or tests/hooks/ (add structural test: grep for ci-llm-review-runner.sh and auto-detect/fetched-assets keywords in CLAUDE.md)
- .test-index (add test → source mapping)

## Implementation Notes
Follow CLAUDE.md governance: one-line items with cross-references to linked docs. Full implementation details belong in plugins/dso/docs/ or the runner script itself.
Example style (from existing Architecture section):
  ```
  **CI llm-review orchestrator** (`plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh`): reads classifier JSON, dispatches tier and overlay agents via llm-api-call.sh; auto-detects local-checkout vs fetched-assets mode via marker file `plugins/dso/.dso-source-of-truth`; does not consult check-usage.sh.
  ```
